items.stem: Sales and operations planning (S&OP) primarily aims to do which of the following?

options.text: Reconcile demand and supply plans into one agreed operating plan
options.rationale: Correct: S&OP balances demand and supply into a single, cross-functional plan.

options.text: Schedule individual machines on the shop floor each hour
options.rationale: That is detailed scheduling/execution, below the S&OP level.

options.text: Negotiate the price of a single purchase order
options.rationale: S&OP is a planning process, not transactional procurement negotiation.

options.text: Design the physical layout of a warehouse
options.rationale: Warehouse layout is a facility-design task, not S&OP.

items.explanation: Correct: S&OP balances demand and supply into a single, cross-functional plan.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: A critical component comes from one supplier in one country. Which action most directly reduces supply risk?

options.text: Qualifying a second source in a different region
options.rationale: Correct: a qualified alternate source in another region reduces single-source and geographic risk.

options.text: Increasing the sales forecast for the finished product
options.rationale: Changing the forecast does not reduce supply-side concentration risk.
Payment terms affect cash flow, not supply risk.

options.text: Switching to a just-in-time replenishment with the same supplier
options.rationale: JIT with the same single source can increase exposure to that supplier's disruption.

items.explanation: Correct: a qualified alternate source in another region reduces single-source and geographic risk.

items.stem: Select TWO metrics that are appropriate for measuring supply chain delivery performance.

options.rationale: Correct: OTIF is a standard measure of delivery reliability.
Correct: order cycle time measures responsiveness of the delivery process.

options.text: Employee headcount in the finance team
options.rationale: Finance headcount is unrelated to delivery performance.
Marketing campaign counts do not measure delivery performance.
This is irrelevant to supply chain delivery.

items.explanation: Correct: OTIF is a standard measure of delivery reliability.
